name: UQ Internship Grants
provider: University of Queensland, Student Enrichment and Success
summary: Grants for UQ students doing an in-person global or embassy internship, prioritising First Nations, low-SES, regional and disabled students.
key: Up to AUD $3,000 for a Global Internship (in-person) and up to AUD $2,000 for a UQ Embassy Internship (in-person).
who: Accepted into an internship supported by the UQ Internships Team.
Enrolled in My Career Adviser or the Employability Award.
Priority for students from under-represented groups such as First Nations, low socioeconomic, regional or remote, or students with disability.
how: Register your internship with the UQ Internship Team, and you're automatically considered for funding.
catches: Funding isn't guaranteed. Virtual internships aren't funded.
The current round covers experiences between 22 November 2026 and 21 February 2027; registration was extended to 11 October 2026.

source.label: UQ Employability: Internship budget and funding
